steps.note: A concentrate of cocoa, sweetener and lambda carrageenan, which keeps the cocoa suspended, is mixed into part of the milk.
The mix is pasteurised, in the HTST way or in a vat at about 71 °C for 20–30 minutes.
It may be homogenised, if wanted.
The concentrate is diluted with more pasteurised milk and stirred for 15–30 minutes before it is packed.

sources.text: The steps and figures are those of one chocolate-milk patent; Wikipedia for flavoured milk sold pasteurised and chilled or UHT-treated, which the patent does not cover.
